facts.fact: UNDP says Madagascar has rolled out a national biometric enrolment programme since 3 April 2026, after a pilot from 27 January 2026 in the 26 communes of Antananarivo Atsimondrano, to give each citizen a unique identification number, with 2 million people targeted by June 2026.
